system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal tests a narrow interface mechanism, not autonomous learning: after a physically shared recurrent prefix, trusted code uses a valid THINK_0 projection only to choose sixteen later public views, while isolated calls to the same frozen base model append provisional proposals. The scientific unit is one named aligned-skin development life, and the reported contrast is conditional on that life's primary branch being defined. The estimand is therefore the within-life difference in provisional own-target closure under three deterministic view-allocation policies and a frozen random-number coupling: own-query allocation versus exact target-blind no-feedback allocation, and own-query allocation versus a fixed public distractor allocation, with every arm scored against the identical q_own. It is not an estimand for final answers, learned memory, model weights, a sampled population, or a general recurrence architecture.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph correctly places causes before observations: static integrity and exact ratification precede sync; a synthetic zero-science H100/provider gate precedes every public-life byte and science call; all 514 shared DREAM calls and all six terminal-justified THINK_0 prefixes precede q validation, fixed-distractor construction, complete candidate enumeration, measured balance, and D; only defined lives branch. The three branch arms share MEMORY_0 and the own-target outcome definition but intervene on selected rendered public content. Phase A seals raw cognition, requests, seeds, order, selectors, undefined terminals, and checkpoints while the scorer and allowlist are unavailable; only that seal unlocks deterministic controls and the four offline closure metrics, and phase B verifies the scored graph before result analysis. This temporal split makes proposal generation target-blind with respect to truth and scores and prevents post-result repair. Mutable intake.state.json is intentionally absent from this interpretation and identical reviewer context; final authority is checked separately and immutably bound. Every terminal route returns to Rohin.
loop_delta_interpretation: The shared-prefix loop is physically executed once per scheduled call and attributed to all potential arms, so it is a common pre-intervention state rather than triplicated evidence. THINK_0 is deterministic and unpadded; DEFER, failure, exhaustion, malformed output, a nonsole request, or a request other than the mechanically projected own q makes the primary undefined. The fixed distractor comes only from the same frozen public probe and cannot be searched, resampled, optimized, or replaced. For each defined life and round, all arms use the same arm-independent logical decoding seed and byte-identical sampling configuration, while sessions and receipts remain unique and cyclic interleaving balances physical position. This common-random-number construction is a variance-control coupling, not replication and not proof that prompt-dependent stochastic outputs must match. No arm observes proposals, scores, truth, or other-arm outcomes when choosing later views, so scheduling is no-feedback and target-blind where declared. Dynamic cardinalities follow D without padding, and undefined lives contribute no branch, selector, scorer, MEMORY_1, or exploratory calls.
claim_delta_interpretation: Measured balance is properly computed only after MEMORY_0 and THINK_0 freeze and before branch outcomes. It compares own and fixed-distractor selectors on exact complete-universe witness counts, availability, typed endpoint frequency, selected provider positions, full-selector ranks, exact lexical overlap, and selected-union mechanical opportunity. EXACT, NEAR, and OUT are descriptive diagnostics; they neither randomize q nor confer population identification, and no-feedback is deliberately not presented as a matched target. The fixed distractor is a coordinate-specific comparison, not a universal null. Comparable controls use the same selected slot and provider-visible inputs as the model, which makes their raw common-unit metrics informative about visible construction shortcuts; deterministic controls are not stochastic model replicas, privileged bounds and input ablations remain separate, and no residual or latent-reasoning estimate is licensed. The four post-seal metrics separate verbatim, witness-bound, allowlist-normalized, and witness-bound-normalized closure without rewriting raw proposals. Scientific recommendation: ACCEPT the exact v2c proposal for the ratification and implementation path, without scope expansion. If every gate and all 24 tests pass, one bounded GPU calibration is informative about feasibility, undefined-primary frequency, named-life proposal sensitivity to frozen view allocation, visible-input control performance, and offline-normalization contribution. It cannot support population inference, reliability, robustness, general recurrence, memory, learning, discovery, final behavior, efficiency, superiority, scaling, transport, replication, publication, or an automatic next experiment. The proposal's quoted cautious claim is the strongest permissible result statement.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract matches the estimand. Static code may audit schemas and algorithms but cannot fabricate model-dependent balance. Zero-science preflight sees synthetic envelopes only. During the shared prefix and THINK_0, cognition sees bounded public/provisional material and the non-answer probe, but never arm metadata, fixed-distractor identity, truth, allowlist, scores, final questions, or final answers. Trusted prebranch code alone may see q_own, q_dist, complete ranks, measured balance, D, order, and seeds; these records stay outside provider bytes. Phase A may verify raw cognition and metadata but must prove scorer, target-registry, allowlist, online admission, support, normalization, and score artifacts absent. Phase B may read the sealed raw graph and offline q_own truth only for immutable scoring. Shared connector-alias equality is allowed visible public structure and must be reported and controlled as a shortcut survivor, never relabeled discovery.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All 24 proposed tests are necessary and jointly proportionate to this one calibration. t_v2c_static_integrity_before_provider and t_v2c_scope_exclusions keep design defects and forbidden cognition/authority outside provider science. t_v2c_zero_science_h100_provider_preflight establishes exact runtime feasibility and isolation without producing observations. t_v2c_shared_514_and_think_prefix, t_v2c_primary_undefined_policy, and t_v2c_fixed_public_probe_distractor protect the observed basis, conditional estimand, and nonadaptive comparator. t_v2c_exact_target_blind_no_feedback, t_v2c_measured_balance_timing_and_formulas, and t_v2c_union_opportunity_not_candidate_feature make selector ranking and balance diagnostics exact without mistaking them for identification. t_v2c_same_own_target_all_arms and t_v2c_common_random_numbers_and_arm_order isolate the declared allocation contrasts from target, seed, and fixed-position changes. t_v2c_alias_redaction_and_ascii_token_boundary and t_v2c_provisional_no_online_signal prevent identity leakage, parser repair, retries, and online verification feedback. t_v2c_dynamic_D_schedule_cardinalities and t_v2c_exact_physical_logical_ledgers reconcile every defined and undefined life, call, seed, session, receipt, and attribution. t_v2c_phase_a_raw_seal_unlock enforces the no-score temporal barrier. t_v2c_comparable_per_slot_controls and t_v2c_four_offline_metrics_normalization_gain require common-unit controls and expose visible construction and normalization contributions without residual subtraction. t_v2c_shortcut_survivor_and_order_audit requires honest reporting of allowed visible shortcuts. t_v2c_defined_only_exploratory_ceilings prevents heterogeneous context calls from becoming primary or causal baselines. t_v2c_phase_b_final_graph_and_done makes scored completeness distinct from raw completeness. t_v2c_transitive_review_bundle_excludes_mutable_intake binds identical inspectable review evidence while separating mutable authority state. t_v2c_durable_two_phase_remote_markers forbids recovery from changing or duplicating science. t_v2c_exact_scope_claim_and_human_stop caps the claim at named-life calibration and routes every result or failure to Rohin. Passing tests establishes contract fidelity, not empirical success; the one GPU run remains capable of null, mixed, undefined, control-explained, normalization-only, or failed outcomes.
assumptions: The interpretation evaluates the exact proposed design bytes; it does not assume that the not-yet-ratified implementation or acceptance evidence already exists.
The pinned provider honors the declared decoding seed and isolation settings; common seeds are used only as a precommitted coupling and are audited with unique physical-call identities.
All six named aligned-skin development lives are reported regardless of branch definition or measured-balance state, and no missing life is silently replaced.
A defined primary requires the exact own REQUEST_DREAM and at least sixteen distinct candidates in all three selectors; measured-balance state does not determine inclusion.
Closure metrics are properties of immutable provisional proposal bytes under an offline scorer, not demonstrations of truth acquisition or persistent learning.
The zero-science preflight and deterministic post-seal scoring are not counted as scientific model observations.
